newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ'S Peters says high dollar needs to be addressed.
newsitem.headline: NZ'S Peters says high dollar needs to be addressed.

text.p: New Zealand First Party leader Winston Peters said on Tuesday the high New Zealand dollar needed to be addressed.

"There are some very real economic difficulties that need to be confronted with regard to an over-inflated Kiwi dollar and high interest rates that are affecting exporters and home owners alike," he said.
Peters said NZ First had entered a coalition with the National Party and had created a new position of Treasurer, an office that would be filled by himself.
